assumptions._note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Info Edge (India), consolidated, Rs crore. History is attributable to Info Edge shareholders (Screener Net Profit replaced by Profit for EPS, see tools/authoring/NAUKRI.patch.js); actual-year other income includes fair-value gains of the AIF trusts and Screener moves most of them to exceptional items. The consolidated P&L is built from four blocks that sum to reported revenue and EBITDA: the three standalone segments (Recruitment, 99acres, Jeevansathi + Shiksha), whose margins are segment results (after their own depreciation and finance costs), and a residual block of subsidiaries and eliminations (EBITDA basis). The 'unallocated' line reconciles segment results to EBITDA: standalone corporate costs less standalone depreciation and finance costs. Forecasts carry no fair-value gains. The stock is valued as the street values it: a sum of the parts of the operating businesses (Recruitment on P/E, 99acres and Jeevansathi/Shiksha on EV/sales), the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes at their 30-Sep-2026 closes less a holding-company discount, unlisted investments at book and cash. The parts are derived in tools/authoring/NAUKRI.val.js, which writes them below.

assumptions._unallocLabel: Corporate costs less standalone D&A and finance costs
assumptions._unallocWhy: Segment results are struck after each segment's depreciation and finance costs, so EBITDA = segment results - corporate costs + standalone D&A + finance costs. Corporate costs Rs89 cr FY26 (Rs25 cr Q1FY27) rising to Rs100 / 110 / 120 cr; standalone D&A Rs89 cr FY26 (Rs24 cr Q1) to Rs97 / 105 / 113 cr; finance costs (leases) Rs21 cr to Rs21 / 22 / 23 cr. Net -Rs18 / -17 / -16 cr (FY26: -Rs21 cr).
assumptions._capexWhy: Asset-light: consolidated capex ~Rs83 cr FY25 and ~Rs73 cr FY26 (Screener CFO less FCF), mostly computers and office fit-outs. Rs85 / 95 / 105 cr.
assumptions._depWhy: FY26 D&A Rs123 cr = 5.7% of average gross block (Rs2,159 cr incl. Rs1,334 cr of acquired intangibles and goodwill); Q1FY27 Rs31 cr. 5.7% gives ~Rs128 cr in FY27E.
assumptions._treasuryWhy: Other income is entered as a build (below), not as a yield on the model's treasury line, because that line also holds the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes (no income) and is net of deferred tax and minorities.
assumptions._otherIncomeWhy: Treasury income on Info Edge's cash (Rs4,963 cr at Mar-26, Rs5,034 cr at Jun-26, in bank deposits and debt funds): standalone other income Rs314 cr FY25, Rs335 cr FY26, Rs93 cr in Q1FY27 (Rs373 cr annualised), ~7% on average cash; plus ~Rs5-10 cr in subsidiaries. Cash grows ~Rs600 cr a year after dividends. No fair-value gains on the AIF portfolios or the listed stakes are forecast (Rs821 cr of such gains sat in FY26 reported other income).
assumptions._interestWhy: Consolidated finance costs Rs27 cr FY26 (Rs21 cr standalone, almost all on office leases), Rs6 cr in Q1FY27. No borrowings of substance.
assumptions._taxWhy: Standalone profit is taxed at ~25.2%; subsidiaries' losses carry no tax credit, and forecasts assume no fair-value gains (so no minorities of note). Our build: standalone PBT x 25.2% / consolidated PBT = 26.8% / 26.4% / 26.2%. FY26 reported 33% includes deferred tax on fair-value gains.
assumptions._payoutWhy: FY26 DPS Rs8.40 (two interims of Rs2.40 and a final of Rs3.60) = 49% of standalone EPS before exceptional items, 38% of consolidated EPS (which included fair-value gains). 50% of forecast consolidated EPS.

saBuild._why: Standalone build used for the valuation: Recruitment is valued on its segment result less ALL standalone corporate costs (Rs89 cr FY26; Rs100 / 110 / 120 cr), taxed at the 25.17% statutory rate. Standalone D&A and finance costs are only used to reconcile segment results to EBITDA (see unallocated).

otherTreasury._why: Moves non-operating items out of working capital and into the treasury line: + bank deposits inside other financial assets (Rs3,640 cr, AR FY26 note 4(f)) - non-controlling interests (Rs2,456 cr, outside investors in the AIFs) - deferred tax liabilities (Rs4,988 cr, mostly on unrealised gains in the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes). Working capital then reflects deferred sales revenue (contract liabilities Rs1,534 cr). Treasury = cash + investments (incl. the listed stakes at their Mar-26 book value) + deposits - borrowings - NCI - deferred tax.

bull.label: Bull
bull.narrative: Hiring recovers beyond GCCs and AI products lift Naukri's growth to 16-17% at a 60%+ margin; 99acres reaches double-digit margins a year early; Recruitment earns JM Financial's 30x; the market values the stakes at full market value (no discount), as Info Edge's own history since 2021 would suggest.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: AI cuts white-collar hiring and recruiters' need for Naukri's database; Recruitment grows ~10% with margins stuck at FY26 levels; 99acres stays loss-making; Recruitment re-rates to IndiaMART's 20x; the holding-company discount returns to its Jun-2026 peak.

cover.headline: The best franchise in Indian internet, priced about right: HOLD
cover.lead: Info Edge owns **Naukri.com**, India's dominant jobs marketplace (FY26 Recruitment revenue ₹2,256 cr at a 57% segment margin), the property site 99acres, Jeevansathi and Shiksha, and **12.4% of Eternal and 12.1% of PB Fintech**. On 30-Sep-2026 those two stakes were worth ₹686 a share, 56% of the ₹1,220 price, and cash another ₹78. We value the company the way the street does, as a **sum of the parts**: Recruitment at **23.5x** Sep-28E profit (the median of the current street multiples), 99acres at 3.75x sales, the stakes at market less a **9% holding-company discount** (Info Edge's own median since Sep-2025: the full Sep-2021 to Jun-2026 median is a large premium, because the market paid 40-90x for Naukri until mid-2025), unlisted investments at book and cash. That gives **{{dcf.tp|inr}} ({{dcf.upside|chg}}): we initiate with HOLD.** Bull {{scen.bull.tp|inr}} (Naukri at 30x, no discount); bear {{scen.bear.tp|inr}} (AI slows hiring, Naukri at IndiaMART's 20x, a 40% discount).

arguments.p: Recruitment billings rose 17.5% in Q1FY27 (GCCs +31%, IT/BPM +15%) after ~10% a year in FY26, and the segment margin reached 58.3%. AI products (AI-Rex at 4,000+ enterprises, candidate services +35%) are adding revenue, not taking it. We forecast Recruitment revenue +14.5% / +13% / +12% and profit after corporate costs of ₹1,298 cr on a Sep-28E basis.

arguments.h: The market has already re-priced Naukri
arguments.p: With the stakes at JM Financial's 25% discount, the price implied ~52x next-year Recruitment profit over 2021-26 (median) and ~28x on 30-Sep-2026. IndiaMART, the only other classifieds stock with a long history, trades 59% below its own five-year median P/E. At 23.5x the operating businesses are worth ₹523 a share in our SOTP.

arguments.h: More than half of what you buy is Eternal and PB Fintech
arguments.p: The stakes (₹592 + ₹94 a share) dominate the value and the share price follows them: every 10% move in Eternal is ~₹54 a share. Info Edge has not sold a share of either since the IPOs. Since early 2026 the market has applied a discount (11% on 30-Sep-2026 on our convention); we assume 9%.

The street (median ₹1,350) is more positive mostly because it uses a higher Naukri multiple (JM 30x) or no discount (Motilal Oswal). Measured consistently, a higher Naukri multiple also means a wider measured discount, so the target barely moves (₹1,290 at 30x). The stock needs either faster Naukri growth or a rally in Eternal to offer 15%.

Eternal's and PB Fintech's share prices: together ~56% of Info Edge's market value.

sections.title: India's job-classifieds monopoly, with a venture portfolio attached

blocks.p: Info Edge runs India's largest online classifieds businesses. **Naukri.com** is where Indian white-collar hiring happens: 118 mn resumes, ~6.97 lakh live jobs and ~1.46 lakh paying recruiters in FY26. Around it sit NaukriGulf (Gulf hiring), Job Hai (blue-collar), candidate services (Naukri 360, FastForward, AI resume and interview tools), AmbitionBox (company reviews), Hirist (tech hiring) and Zwayam/DoSelect (hiring software). **99acres.com** is the traffic leader in property classifieds; **Jeevansathi.com** a matrimony site (plus the Aisle dating app); **Shiksha.com** a college-discovery site. For many years Info Edge has also invested in start-ups from its balance sheet and through venture funds (AIFs) it manages; two of those investments, Zomato (now Eternal) and Policybazaar (PB Fintech), became large listed companies.

Second, what is left for the operating businesses (~₹412 a share, or ~18.0x our Sep-28E Recruitment profit if the stakes are at full market value) is low for a business with a 57% segment margin and no competitor of similar scale. The stock is cheap on Naukri only if the market should not discount the stakes, and the market has discounted them since early 2026.

sections.title: Online classifieds: winner-takes-most markets, now tested by AI

blocks.p: Classifieds are two-sided marketplaces: job-seekers go where the jobs are and recruiters pay to reach the most candidates, so the leader tends to keep winning. In Indian white-collar hiring that leader is Naukri. Online job classifieds in India are a near-monopoly for Naukri in white-collar hiring: 118 mn resumes, ~25,000 added and ~8.6 lakh modified a day, 1.46 lakh billed customers in FY26 (Q1FY27 deck). Competitors are LinkedIn (professional network, strong in premium hiring), foundit (ex-Monster India), Indeed and Apna/WorkIndia in blue-collar hiring. Demand is driven by IT services and GCC hiring (~45% of B2B billings incl. GCCs), consultants (~24%) and other sectors (~28%).

99acres competes with Housing.com/PropTiger (REA Group), MagicBricks (Times Internet), NoBroker and builders' own channels; management estimates the new-project advertising market at over Rs5,000 cr. 99acres' web time-share was 49% and app 55% in Q1FY27 (SimilarWeb). Jeevansathi is number two or three behind Matrimony.com (BharatMatrimony) and Shaadi.com; strongest in Hindi-speaking markets (45%+ profile share). Shiksha (college discovery and study-abroad counselling) is losing referred search traffic as AI answers replace search results.

blocks.p: **Verdict.** Naukri has a real and wide moat: network effects (the most candidates attract the most recruiters, and the reverse), paid-in-advance subscriptions, a 56.6% segment margin and no competitor of similar scale in Indian white-collar hiring after decades. LinkedIn is the closest threat at the premium end. 99acres has scale in traffic but not yet in profit; Jeevansathi is a distant challenger and Shiksha's model is being undermined by AI search. The moat is in one business, and that business is ~74% of standalone revenue and all of its profit.

blocks.callout: **What would break the moat:** a shift in how hiring happens (AI agents sourcing candidates across the open web and social networks; companies hiring through their own platforms) rather than a rival job board. Management argues that owning both sides of the marketplace and the resume data makes Naukri stronger in an AI world, and so far the numbers agree: billings accelerated in Q1FY27 and AI products are selling.

sections.title: The operating business doubled in four years; reported profit is mostly fair-value gains

blocks.p: Info Edge's standalone business (Naukri, 99acres, Jeevansathi, Shiksha) grew revenue from ₹1,563 cr in FY22 to ₹3,052 cr in FY26 (18% a year) and operating profit before other income from ₹419 cr to ₹1,138 cr (28% a year). Almost all of it is Recruitment: its segment result was ₹1,277 cr in FY26, more than the whole standalone operating profit, because 99acres still lost ₹59 cr. Reported consolidated profit tells a different and misleading story: ₹12,760 cr in FY22 (the Zomato listing gain), a loss in FY23 (write-downs), ₹1,450 cr in FY26. It swings with fair-value gains on the venture funds, write-offs of start-ups and the losses of consolidated subsidiaries. Standalone EPS before exceptional items, the number management reports, rose from ₹7.16 (FY22) to ₹17.04 (FY26), 24% a year.

blocks.h: The holding-company discount: derived from Info Edge's own history

blocks.p: House method (as in our Godrej Industries and Tube Investments reports): at every quarter-end since Eternal listed (first quarter-end Sep-2021) we compare Info Edge's market value with what it owns on the same conventions as our SOTP: Recruitment at 23.5x the next fiscal year's profit after corporate costs (actual, our estimates for FY27-28), 99acres at 3.75x and Jeevansathi/Shiksha at 2x the next year's revenue, cash at the preceding March and unlisted investments at book. What is left of the market value is what the market pays for the two stakes; the **discount** is how far that falls short of their market value.

blocks.p: **Judging the median against today.** On this convention Info Edge traded at a large *premium* to its look-through value for most of the window (median -85.5%). That is not a holding-company premium: until mid-2025 the market paid 40-90x for Naukri's profit (step 2 above), far more than the 23.5x we and the street use today, and the gap shows up as a negative "discount". Naukri's own re-rating ran through 2025: by Sep-2025 the implied multiple was ~37x and from Mar-2026 it has been 19-28x, inside today's street range. Only the quarter-ends since then measure a discount on a like-for-like basis: Sep-25 -4.0%, Dec-25 -19.0%, Mar-26 21.0%, Jun-26 40.0%, median **8.5%**, against **11.3%** on 30-Sep-2026. So our base 9% is a judgement on a short window, close to today's level and well below JM's 25%. The bull case uses the full-window median floored at zero (no discount, as Motilal Oswal assumes); the bear case the widest quarter-end since Sep-2025 (40%, Jun-2026). assumptions._note: GAM Research forecast drivers for Info Edge (India), consolidated, Rs crore. History is attributable to Info Edge shareholders (Screener Net Profit replaced by Profit for EPS, see tools/authoring/NAUKRI.patch.js); actual-year other income includes fair-value gains of the AIF trusts and Screener moves most of them to exceptional items. The consolidated P&L is built from four blocks that sum to reported revenue and EBITDA: the three standalone segments (Recruitment, 99acres, Jeevansathi + Shiksha), whose margins are segment results (after their own depreciation and finance costs), and a residual block of subsidiaries and eliminations (EBITDA basis). The 'unallocated' line reconciles segment results to EBITDA: standalone corporate costs less standalone depreciation and finance costs. Forecasts carry no fair-value gains. The stock is valued as the street values it: a sum of the parts of the operating businesses (Recruitment on P/E, 99acres and Jeevansathi/Shiksha on EV/sales), the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes at their 30-Sep-2026 closes less a holding-company discount, unlisted investments at book and cash. The parts are derived in tools/authoring/NAUKRI.val.js, which writes them below.

assumptions._unallocLabel: Corporate costs less standalone D&A and finance costs
assumptions._unallocWhy: Segment results are struck after each segment's depreciation and finance costs, so EBITDA = segment results - corporate costs + standalone D&A + finance costs. Corporate costs Rs89 cr FY26 (Rs25 cr Q1FY27) rising to Rs100 / 110 / 120 cr; standalone D&A Rs89 cr FY26 (Rs24 cr Q1) to Rs97 / 105 / 113 cr; finance costs (leases) Rs21 cr to Rs21 / 22 / 23 cr. Net -Rs18 / -17 / -16 cr (FY26: -Rs21 cr).
assumptions._capexWhy: Asset-light: consolidated capex ~Rs83 cr FY25 and ~Rs73 cr FY26 (Screener CFO less FCF), mostly computers and office fit-outs. Rs85 / 95 / 105 cr.
assumptions._depWhy: FY26 D&A Rs123 cr = 5.7% of average gross block (Rs2,159 cr incl. Rs1,334 cr of acquired intangibles and goodwill); Q1FY27 Rs31 cr. 5.7% gives ~Rs128 cr in FY27E.
assumptions._treasuryWhy: Other income is entered as a build (below), not as a yield on the model's treasury line, because that line also holds the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes (no income) and is net of deferred tax and minorities.
assumptions._otherIncomeWhy: Treasury income on Info Edge's cash (Rs4,963 cr at Mar-26, Rs5,034 cr at Jun-26, in bank deposits and debt funds): standalone other income Rs314 cr FY25, Rs335 cr FY26, Rs93 cr in Q1FY27 (Rs373 cr annualised), ~7% on average cash; plus ~Rs5-10 cr in subsidiaries. Cash grows ~Rs600 cr a year after dividends. No fair-value gains on the AIF portfolios or the listed stakes are forecast (Rs821 cr of such gains sat in FY26 reported other income).
assumptions._interestWhy: Consolidated finance costs Rs27 cr FY26 (Rs21 cr standalone, almost all on office leases), Rs6 cr in Q1FY27. No borrowings of substance.
assumptions._taxWhy: Standalone profit is taxed at ~25.2%; subsidiaries' losses carry no tax credit, and forecasts assume no fair-value gains (so no minorities of note). Our build: standalone PBT x 25.2% / consolidated PBT = 26.8% / 26.4% / 26.2%. FY26 reported 33% includes deferred tax on fair-value gains.
assumptions._payoutWhy: FY26 DPS Rs8.40 (two interims of Rs2.40 and a final of Rs3.60) = 49% of standalone EPS before exceptional items, 38% of consolidated EPS (which included fair-value gains). 50% of forecast consolidated EPS.

saBuild._why: Standalone build used for the valuation: Recruitment is valued on its segment result less ALL standalone corporate costs (Rs89 cr FY26; Rs100 / 110 / 120 cr), taxed at the 25.17% statutory rate. Standalone D&A and finance costs are only used to reconcile segment results to EBITDA (see unallocated).

otherTreasury._why: Moves non-operating items out of working capital and into the treasury line: + bank deposits inside other financial assets (Rs3,640 cr, AR FY26 note 4(f)) - non-controlling interests (Rs2,456 cr, outside investors in the AIFs) - deferred tax liabilities (Rs4,988 cr, mostly on unrealised gains in the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes). Working capital then reflects deferred sales revenue (contract liabilities Rs1,534 cr). Treasury = cash + investments (incl. the listed stakes at their Mar-26 book value) + deposits - borrowings - NCI - deferred tax.

bull.narrative: Hiring recovers beyond GCCs and AI products lift Naukri's growth to 16-17% at a 60%+ margin; 99acres reaches double-digit margins a year early; Recruitment earns JM Financial's 30x; the market values the stakes at full market value (no discount), as Info Edge's own history since 2021 would suggest.

bear.label: Bear
bear.narrative: AI cuts white-collar hiring and recruiters' need for Naukri's database; Recruitment grows ~10% with margins stuck at FY26 levels; 99acres stays loss-making; Recruitment re-rates to IndiaMART's 20x; the holding-company discount returns to its Jun-2026 peak.
